name: Factory Garrisons
text: Ongoing: each round, every adversary factory musters 1 Troop on its hex (a player Ambassador on it stops it).

name: Night Raid
text: Corrupt: nodes. Each country: the node hex holding the most Agents (at least 1; ties: lowest-numbered) loses its node.

name: War Footing
text: Every military base fills with Drones to its cap.

name: Shadow Factories
text: The adversary builds a factory in the country with the most free industrial zones (none free: 2 Agents on a factory).

name: Hostile Takeover
text: Rally 2, each country: factories. Corrupt: factories.

name: Asset Seizure
text: Each country: its neutral factory with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) goes to the adversary; with none neutral, its player-owned factory with the most turns neutral.

name: War Plants
text: The adversary builds a factory in the country with the most free industrial zones (none free: 2 Agents on a factory). Every adversary factory musters 1 Troop on its hex.

name: Botnet Swarm
text: Each country: a botnet spreads to its lowest-numbered city, research station or factory next to one of its botnets (no botnet there: its lowest-numbered research station).

name: Station Coup
text: Each country: its neutral research station with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) goes to the adversary; with none neutral, its player-owned station with the most turns neutral.

name: Backdoor Research
text: 2 adversary research cubes onto each open megaproject.

name: Data Heist
text: Each player removes 3 tokens from their cards (their choice of cards). Each player pays 8 credits or discards 2 cards.

name: Botnet Conscripts
text: Each country: its lowest-numbered botnet becomes 2 Troops on its hex.

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Income: +1 Agent a country a round.

name: Infiltration Drive
text: Rally 3, each country: cities. Corrupt: cities (1 fewer).

name: Mob Rule
text: Rally 2, each country: cities. Each country: the node hex holding the most Agents (at least 1; ties: lowest-numbered) loses its node.

name: Disinformation
text: Sway 5 toward Discord.

name: Rolling Blackouts
text: Until the end of next round, cities make no energy.

name: Sabotage Teams
text: Each country: the hardened facility with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) loses its hardening. Each country: the node hex holding the most Agents (at least 1; ties: lowest-numbered) loses its node.

name: False Flag
text: Each country: an extra tier-2 threat, any tag.

name: Grand Offensive
text: Each country rallies its Agent income now, to this round's Rally. Corrupt: cities.

name: Propaganda Network
text: Now: Income: +2 compute a round. Ongoing: Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Accelerated Timetable
text: Discard the top card of the adversary's event deck: the round cap comes a round sooner.
